title: William the Conqueror
summary: Raleigh names William the Conqueror in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). William the Conqueror, named onely as an example, that neerenesse of time doth not proue a man to be sonne or grand-child. He is not William of Tyre. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXV, §. I, sig. 351a–351b
